name: Grignolino del Monferrato Casalese

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Piedmont DOC for wine made from at least 95% Grignolino, with Freisa and Barbera allowed for the rest. Its rules also cover a quality sparkling rosé.
